=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:645-651 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `test_implement_progress_counter_ignores_other_issue_runs` runs with the default `terminal_timeout="0"`, so INACTIVITY_LIMIT=0 and the step exits with status=timeout before the `impl_runs:` echo at workflow line 1574. The assertion `impl_runs: 0 total` at line 649 therefore fails.
  WHY: CI check `tests-release-and-log-analysis` already fails on this assertion. The reviewers called it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical. The suggested fix is `terminal_timeout="2"` and changing the page-count assertion at line 651 from 1 to 2.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:600-604 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test's page 1 holds only `ALT_TITLE` runs, so the new counter walks to the bad page 2 and fails closed. `IMPL_RUN_TOTAL` stays 0 and `scoped_implement_runs_complete` is never entered.
  WHY: The test passes only because the counter failed closed, so the terminal helper's handling of unreadable or malformed pages is no longer covered. Severity disagreement: two reviewers said MAJOR, one said NIT; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1419-1439 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `scoped_implement_progress_counts` makes up to 10 `per_page=100` API calls on every 10-second poll (call site lines 1478-1481), with no throttle like the terminal walk's `SCOPED_IMPL_NEXT_WALK`.
  WHY: Over a 1800-second phase this can reach about 1800 calls against the shared `GH_PAT` quota instead of about 180. Quota exhaustion makes the counter fail closed, which loses the run information this change is meant to capture. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1419-1439 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The counter fails closed on any unreadable or invalid page among up to ten (lines 1420 and 1428 `return 1`), and the caller resets `IMPL_RUN_TOTAL` to 0. The gate at line 1519 is then not satisfied.
  WHY: A transient read failure on any page suppresses the `implement_failed` diagnostic and falls back to the 30-minute timeout, on a strictly larger set of failures than before.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1485-1488 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `IMPL_PREV_LABELS` is overwritten on a failed label read (`|| echo ""` at line 1476). It is also initialised empty at line 1448, so a cycle that starts and ends between two polls is missed. In either case the "returned to ai:awaiting-approval" log line does not print.
  WHY: Only the diagnostic is lost; the `implement_failed` path still names the run and conclusion.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1421-1428 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The jq selection and fail-closed validation is duplicated between `scoped_implement_progress_counts` (lines 1421-1428) and `scoped_implement_runs_complete` (lines 1327-1334), and the walk semantics already differ.
  WHY: The two copies can drift, and CI would not catch it; the test at line 668 only checks for a shared substring. This is a maintenance risk, not a current defect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
